evals.name: simple-badge-no-radix
evals.prompt: Add a Badge component to the library. It should support a few color variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline) and render as a small pill-shaped label. We use it to tag statuses on cards.
evals.expected_output: A components/v2/Badge/ slice: Badge.tsx (forwardRef + cn, no Radix needed — it's static markup), badge-variants.ts (cva with the 4 variants using ONLY standard semantic utilities like bg-primary/bg-secondary/bg-destructive/border-input, no hardcoded colors), Badge.types.ts (native span attrs + VariantProps + asChild?), Badge.stories.tsx (incl. a DarkMode story with both data-theme=dark and .dark, max-w-2xl). No component-token block, no atom/molecule folders.

evals.name: radix-tooltip-compound
evals.prompt: I need a Tooltip component for the design system. It should show a small text label on hover/focus over any trigger element, positioned above by default. Make it accessible.
evals.expected_output: A components/v2/Tooltip/ slice built on @radix-ui/react-tooltip (NOT hand-rolled hover/focus/positioning/aria). Named sub-component exports wrapping Radix parts (Provider/Root/Trigger/Content), each styled with cn() + semantic utilities (bg-popover text-popover-foreground etc.). asChild used so any element can be the trigger. Install command uses pnpm (pnpm add @radix-ui/react-tooltip), NOT npm install. DarkMode story with both selectors. No hand-rolled focus/escape/positioning.

evals.name: command-palette-cmdk-recipe
evals.prompt: Build a command palette (Cmd+K style) that pops open, lets the user type to filter a list of actions, and navigate the results with arrow keys. Like the one in VS Code or Linear.
evals.expected_output: Should recognize this is the Popover + cmdk recipe and REUSE/build on the already-shipped components/v2/Command/ and components/v2/Combobox/ rather than reimplementing keyboard nav, filtering, and aria-activedescendant from scratch. Should read those existing components first. If it adds a new component, it composes Command inside a Dialog/Popover. Uses npm for any install. No hand-rolled roving-tabindex / arrow-key handling.
